description: Mints a one-time enrollment token and returns the install command for the machine this agent runs on. On Linux the installer needs root; on a Mac it runs without sudo. The token is shown once. Ask the machine's owner before running it. Nothing is listed until the owner approves. Pass owner_account_id to enroll a machine onto an owner's fleet you were delegated.

owner_account_id.description: Owner account id when this key manages that owner's fleet. Omit to act as the key's own account.

name: host_this_machine
title: Earn with this machine's GPU
